description: This script automates the installation of host system binaries along with required libraries. It includes functions for copying, moving, creating symlinks, patching binaries, and bundling shared objects, specifically tailored for setting up environment with custom linking and patched libraries.

methods.name: _cp
methods.description: Copies files with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _mv
methods.description: Moves files with optional verbose output, exits on failure.

methods.name: _md
methods.description: Creates directories, including parent directories, with verbose support.

methods.name: _ln
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link, overwriting if necessary, with verbose support.

methods.name: _relpath
methods.description: Calculates a relative path from the binary to the library directory.

methods.name: _runas_so
methods.description: Generates a shared object library for runtime argument mangling.

methods.name: _patch_ldso
methods.description: Patches a dynamic linker binary to modify library paths.

methods.name: _patch_glibc
methods.description: Patches glibc binaries to modify locale and share library paths.

methods.name: should_be_patched
methods.description: Determines whether a binary should be patched based on its type and ELF headers.
